title: Commonwealth Gas Company files for review and approval by the Department an agreement for quasi-firm transportation service with Baystate/Sterling Inc.
filings: The Agreement is hereby approved. The Department also finds information regarding the pricing terms and minimum quantity of therms to be purchased under the Agreement is competitively sensitive, and, therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; John D. Patrone, James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Paul Vasington, Commissioners.
Commonwealth Gas Company responses to Department Information requests DTE 1-1 through DTE 1-6. By. David T. Griffiths, Senior Rate Analyst, ComGas.
Department's First Set of Information Requests. Submitted by: Andrew O. Kaplan.
